newTests.name:
`platform/parse-proc-net-route-gateway` turns the kernel's little-endian hex
   route table into the dotted-quad gateway of the default route. > tables with no usable default route > returns nil when the only default route is on-link (gateway 0.0.0.0)

`platform/parse-proc-net-route-gateway` turns the kernel's little-endian hex
   route table into the dotted-quad gateway of the default route. > WSL2 NAT route table > tolerates space separators and leading whitespace

`platform/parse-proc-net-route-gateway` turns the kernel's little-endian hex
   route table into the dotted-quad gateway of the default route. > tables with no usable default route > returns nil for a header-only table

`platform/read-proc-net-route` is the impure half: it either returns the
   file's text or nil, and never throws. > agrees with wsl-default-gateway-ip inside WSL

`platform/parse-proc-net-route-gateway` turns the kernel's little-endian hex
   route table into the dotted-quad gateway of the default route. > tables with no usable default route > returns nil for an empty table, empty string, or nil

`platform/parse-proc-net-route-gateway` turns the kernel's little-endian hex
   route table into the dotted-quad gateway of the default route. > WSL2 NAT route table > picks the default route even when it is not the first data row

`platform/read-proc-net-route` is the impure half: it either returns the
   file's text or nil, and never throws. > returns a string on Linux/WSL and nil elsewhere, never throws

`platform/parse-proc-net-route-gateway` turns the kernel's little-endian hex
   route table into the dotted-quad gateway of the default route. > WSL2 NAT route table > decodes the default route's gateway

`platform/parse-proc-net-route-gateway` turns the kernel's little-endian hex
   route table into the dotted-quad gateway of the default route. > tables with no usable default route > returns nil for a truncated row

`platform/parse-proc-net-route-gateway` turns the kernel's little-endian hex
   route table into the dotted-quad gateway of the default route. > tables with no usable default route > returns nil for a non-hex gateway column
